Method.name: AssessmentPdfSendFax
Method.Implementation:
$$$TRACE("In AssessmentPdfSendFax()") if pRequest.recipient.GetAt(1).number="" { $$$TRACE("Fax number is empty ...") set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).InputDataError(..%ConfigName, " Fax number is empty... ") Quit %objlasterror } $$$TRACE("Calling Xmedius service")
Set ..Adapter.WebServiceClientClass = "XM2.FaxServicePort"
Set tSC = ..Adapter.InvokeMethod("verifyUserPassword",.verification,..usrNm,..pswrd) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC $$$TRACE("Verify User & Password Response: "_verification) Set tSC = ..Adapter.InvokeMethod("sendFax",.result,..usrNm,pRequest.subject,pRequest.comment,pRequest.recipient,pRequest.attachment,..FaxCoverPage,pRequest.senderInfo,pRequest.faxOptions) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC Set tSC = pRequest.NewResponse(.pResp) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC $$$TRACE("Response: "_result.broadcastId) set recCnt=result.transactionId.Count() for i=1:1:recCnt { set val=result.transactionId.GetAt(i) $$$TRACE("Transaction ID: "_val) }
$$$TRACE("Response: "_result.transactionId.Count())
set pResponse=##class(Ens.StringResponse).%New() set pResponse.StringValue="Fax data has been sent to Xmedius Service successfully."
Quit tSC
